name: 取り組みの説明セクション
prompt:
Create one clean, static Japanese description section that matches the first reference mock as closely as possible. Treat the mock as the exact authority for the 700 x 220 px white crop, all Japanese text, glyph scale, line breaks, left alignment, and vertical placement. The second reference is an English source focus crop and provides only the semantic structure of a small description label followed by two paragraphs.

Render this exact Japanese text and preserve these line breaks:
説明
目標、利用者像、解決すべき課題を定義して、活動の基盤を整えます。
利用者の声、体験の流れ、提供する価値、成果の基準を順に確認します。

この取り組みを通じて、設計と実行の方向を共有し、
確認できた知見に基づいて判断できるようにします。

Match the mock's flush crop placement. Do not add inner padding, a card, a page margin, or center the text. The first label begins at the far left near the top edge. The first body line begins near x=0 and y=42 px; keep the next body line 24 px below it. Start the second paragraph at about y=114 px and keep its second line 24 px below. Match the mock's visible body glyph size (about 14 px high at 700 px canvas width). Use the approved Lighthouse typography: Meiryo Regular, quiet label 12 px with 16 px line height, body 14 px with 24 px line height.

Use restrained dark neutral body text and a quiet gray label on white with strong contrast. Keep the section compact and content-first. No border, shadow, colored surface, icons, controls, buttons, page chrome, extra labels, or extra wording. Do not paraphrase or invent text. The result is static text with no implied behavior.
reviewNotes: Attempt 2 selected after direct comparison with the 700x220 Japanese mock. Exact Japanese copy, line breaks and overall placement match closely. Empty canvas samples range from #FDFDFD to #FFFFFF with subtle texture, while current catalog guidance requires a pure white #FFFFFF outer canvas. Both authorized ImageGen attempts are preserved; no pixels were modified. Register needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
